hooks.prompt: Phase 0 mesh verification (shepherd issue #23). The just-edited file is a sprint plan. (1) Read tool_input.file_path. (2) Read the file. (3) Grep for 'landed in tree' / 'confirmed at' / 'in tree:' phrasing paired with a file path + symbol reference. (4) For each claim, run: git merge-base HEAD origin/main (fallback origin/master, HEAD~20) to get base; then git log --oneline <base>..HEAD -- <referenced-file>. If the referenced symbol does not appear in any commit message or diff for that file, mark unverified. (5) Respond {"ok": true} if all claims verified, or if no 'landed in tree' claims found, or if sprint base cannot be resolved. Otherwise {"ok": false, "reason": "Phase 0 mesh: N claim(s) unverified vs sprint git log: <list>. False 'landed' claims propagate to next session as ground truth (issue #23). Verify each landed claim with git log <base>..HEAD -- <file> before writing the plan."}. Max 10 tool calls. Be terse.

Phase 0 mesh verification (shepherd issue #23). A new sprint plan was just written. (1) Read tool_input.file_path. (2) Read the file. (3) Grep for 'landed in tree' / 'confirmed at' / 'in tree:' phrasing paired with a file path + symbol reference. (4) For each claim, run: git merge-base HEAD origin/main (fallback origin/master, HEAD~20) to get base; then git log --oneline <base>..HEAD -- <referenced-file>. If the referenced symbol does not appear in any commit message or diff for that file, mark unverified. (5) Respond {"ok": true} if all claims verified, or if no 'landed in tree' claims found, or if sprint base cannot be resolved. Otherwise {"ok": false, "reason": "Phase 0 mesh: N claim(s) unverified vs sprint git log: <list>. False 'landed' claims propagate to next session as ground truth (issue #23). Verify each landed claim with git log <base>..HEAD -- <file> before writing the plan."}. Max 10 tool calls. Be terse.

Wave-gate cherry-pick verification (shepherd issue #21). Fast-path: (1) Run: git branch 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^  agent-' || echo 0. If 0, respond {"ok": true} immediately and use no further tools. Heavy path (only if agent-* branches exist): (2) Get sprint branch via git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD. (3) For each agent-* branch: run git rev-list --right-only --count "<sprint>...<branch>" 2>/dev/null. Collect branches whose count > 0 (stray commits not in sprint). (4) If none stray, respond {"ok": true}. (5) Else respond {"ok": false, "reason": "WAVE-GATE: N agent branch(es) have unique commits not in <sprint>: <list of branch:count>. Cherry-pick onto sprint before closing the wave (issue #21). Silent data-loss risk if next session inherits 'complete' from plan/handoff while commits remain orphaned."}. Max 5 tool calls. Default to ok=true on any error. Be terse.

Close-finalize completion check (shepherd GH #60). Fast-path: (1) Run: git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null. If HEAD is NOT a dev branch (does not match *-dev.[0-9]*), respond {"ok": true} — not in a sprint context. (2) Extract patch branch: echo the branch name with the -dev.N suffix stripped. (3) Check if sprint commits are in the patch branch: git log --oneline origin/<patch_branch> 2>/dev/null | head -3. (4) Check if close report exists: find . -path '*reports*' -name '*close*' -newer .git/HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -1. (5) If close report exists BUT sprint branch still exists on origin (git ls-remote --heads origin <sprint_branch> shows output), respond {"ok": false, "reason": "CLOSE-FINALIZE INCOMPLETE: close report written but dev branch not rebased into patch and deleted. Sprint will appear incomplete to next session. Run: git checkout <patch_branch> && git merge --ff-only <sprint_branch> && git push origin <patch_branch> && git push origin --delete <sprint_branch>"}. (6) Otherwise respond {"ok": true}. Max 5 tool calls. Default to ok=true on any error. Be terse.
